<script>
(function () {
  var box = document.getElementById("recipe-search");
  var items = [].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll("#recipe-list li"));
  var count = document.getElementById("recipe-count"), none = document.getElementById("recipe-none");
  function filter() {
    var terms = box.value.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean), shown = 0;
    items.forEach(function (li) {
      var hay = li.getAttribute("data-search");
      var hit = terms.every(function (t) { return hay.indexOf(t) !== -1; });
      li.hidden = !hit; if (hit) shown++;
    });
    count.textContent = terms.length ? shown + " of " + items.length + " recipes" : items.length + " recipes";
    none.hidden = shown !== 0;
  }
  box.addEventListener("input", filter);
  // ?q=chicken in the address opens the page already filtered
  var q = /[?&]q=([^&]*)/.exec(location.search);
  if (q) box.value = decodeURIComponent(q[1].replace(/\+/g, " "));
  filter();
})();
</script>
